scope: 80 previously examined cards, including M19 after its separate lower-frame validation. Same printing inputs and loyalty anchors; this is a glyph-bound safety correction and confirmation, not fresh typography validation.
limitations: Paper limits and eight-pixel gaps do not certify loyalty-silhouette clearance, printed line wrapping, font match or badge placement.
Regional edge scores are raw and conditional on unverified printing text, not percent accuracy.

timing.scope: CPU cached PNG comparison and captured glyph bounds; no Chromium or GPU work.
